Identify the objective tested by matching business scenarios to AI workload families.
Identify the objective tested by distinguishing sentiment, entities, key phrases, and language detection.
Identify the objective tested by choosing recognition, synthesis, or spoken multimodal prompting.

transfer.prompt: A review asks for privacy, inclusiveness, transparency, and human accountability evidence.
A learner explains why probabilistic token generation is not database lookup.
A learner compares capability, latency, cost, deployment, and parameter tradeoffs.
A new scenario must be classified as prediction, language, speech, vision, generation, or extraction.
A report needs organizations and sentiment extracted from existing text.
A new accessibility case maps audio to captions and text to spoken playback.
A new case contrasts interpreting an existing diagram with creating a new illustration.
A schema must extract evidence from mixed document, image, audio, and video inputs.
An unseen prompt-injection case requires stable instructions, grounding-as-data, and safe fallback.
A portal rehearsal distinguishes project, model, deployment, readiness, and safe cleanup.
A broken client confuses its project endpoint with the deployment name.
An agent tool fails and the solution must not fabricate success or treat capability as permission.
A batch language item errors while a speech operation cancels; both require explicit branches.
Generated media must be labeled and kept separate from observed visual evidence.
An extraction result omits unsupported fields and must preserve nulls, spans, and source references.
